title: Simulation 3D Dolly
text: 在 3D 环境中实现台车，输入 2 路；按 {Type} 指定Type One-axle；{Name} 指定台车名称 SimulinkVehicle1、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} 指定车辆初始平移 zeros、{Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} 指定初始旋转 zeros，按实例取值。

ports.name: Translation
ports.summary: 台车平移 5 -by- 3 array (default) | 8 -by- 3 array | 11 -by- 3 array

ports.name: Rotation
ports.summary: 台车旋转 5 -by- 3 array (default) | 8 -by- 3 array | 11 -by- 3 array

params.name: Type
params.values: Type One-axle dolly (default) | Two-axle dolly | Three-axle dolly

params.name: Name
params.values: 台车名称 SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
params.values: 车辆初始平移 zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | zeros( 8, 3 ) | zeros( 11, 3 )

params.name: Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
params.values: 初始旋转 zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | zeros( 8, 3 ) | zeros( 11, 3 )
